何钰身形难支，更是直接气昏了过去。
“爹，你先带娘进去，这里的事我来处理。”
叶凡可不想爹娘再受什么刺激，忙对叶海道。
眼前这俩贱人太不要脸了，啥话都说得出口。
叶海冷声一喝，焦急地扶着何钰回屋。
叶凡随即转过身，话音微冷，“陈淑怡，林清月，你们是不是还觉得，我是以前那个任你们欺负的舔狗？”
陈淑怡不屑地撇了撇嘴，“就你这种废物，也配拒绝清月？别给脸不要脸。我告诉你，今晚这婚，你结也得结，不结也得结！劝你别把事情闹大，就当什么都不知道，好好当你的新郎。否则，别怪我们不客气！”
叶凡笑了，“是不是要我乖乖当舔狗，娶了林清月，等孩子生下来，我跟孩子姓，你们才满意啊？”
陈淑怡还以为叶凡开窍了，真敢答应。
叶凡冷笑了下，瞥了眼林清月道，“就林清月这种烂货，给我做小的都不配！当通房丫头我都嫌技术差。”
论姿色、实力、身份，林清月没一样比得上秦以沫。
吃过山珍海味，哪还看得上粗茶淡饭？
何况，林清月顶多只能算残羹冷炙！
陈淑怡意识到自己被戏耍，刹那拔出腰间长剑，直指叶凡，“废物东西，敬酒不吃吃罚酒！还敢出言不逊，今天我就替清月好好教训教训你！”
“叶凡哥哥只是一时糊涂，淑怡你别冲动……”
林清月嘴上劝了句，手上却无任何阻拦动作。
叶凡一阵作呕，知道林清月就是装装样子，“林清月，人家三十而立，你年方十八，又当又立啊？”

陈淑怡闻言火更大了，身上灵武境一阶气息喷发，“一个气武境的废物，不给他点颜色看看，他还真以为自己是个东西了！”
话音未落，手中长剑已朝叶凡刺了过来。
叶凡注视着陈淑怡杀来，站在原地一动不动。
直至剑尖即将触及其胸口时，才突然抬手。
武技炽阳手施展，手化金色一把抓住了剑刃。
自己刺出的剑，竟然被叶凡徒手接住？
“就这点本事，也敢在我面前嚣张？”
陈淑怡吓得后退两步，险些没站稳。
金色灵力随即弥漫而出，萦绕周身。
修为不是灵武境二阶，更不是气武境。
他一路晒着太阳回皇城，又进阶了。

He Yu couldn't help himself, and even fainted from anger.
"Dad, you take mother in first, and I'll take care of the things here."
Ye Fan didn't want his parents to be stimulated anymore, so he hurriedly said to Ye Haida.
These two bitches in front of me are so shameless and can say anything.
Ye Hai shouted coldly and anxiously helped He Yu back to the house.
Ye Fan immediately turned around and said with a cold voice, "Chen Shuyi, Lin Qingyue, do you still think that I am the licking dog that you bullied before?"
Chen Shuyi curled her lips disdainfully, "A waste like you is worthy of rejecting Qingyue? Don't be shameless. I tell you, you have to get married tonight or not! I advise you not to make a big deal out of it, just pretend you don't know anything and be your groom. Otherwise, don't blame us for being rude!"
Ye Fan smiled, "Do you want me to be a licking dog, marry Lin Qingyue, and when the child is born, you will be satisfied if I take the child's last name?"
Chen Shuyi thought that Ye Fan was enlightened and she really dared to agree.
Ye Fan sneered, glanced at Lin Qingyue and said, "A bastard like Lin Qingyue is not worthy of being a small girl for me! I even think that my skills are poor when I am a girl with a common relationship."
In terms of beauty, strength, and status, Lin Qingyue was not as good as Qin Yimo.
After eating delicacies from the mountains and seas, how can I still appreciate the simple meals?
What's more, Lin Qingyue can only be regarded as scraps at best!
Chen Shuyi realized that she was being played, and immediately pulled out the long sword from her waist and pointed it at Ye Fan, "You trash, you will be fined if you don't eat the toast! If you dare to speak rudely, I will teach you a lesson for Qingyue today!"
"Brother Ye Fan is just confused for a moment, Shuyi, don't be impulsive..."
Lin Qingyue tried to persuade her, but her hands made no move to stop him.
Ye Fan felt nauseated for a while, knowing that Lin Qingyue was just pretending, "Lin Qingyue, I am thirty years old, but you are eighteen years old, how can you be so important at the same time?"
Chen Shuyi became even more angry when she heard this, and the aura of the first level of the Lingwu Realm erupted from her body, "A waste of the Qi Martial Realm, if you don't give him some color, he really thinks he is a thing!"
Before he finished speaking, the long sword in his hand was already stabbing Ye Fan.
Ye Fan watched Chen Shuyi coming and stood motionless.
It wasn't until the tip of the sword was about to touch his chest that he suddenly raised his hand.
The martial art Blazing Sun Hand was used, and the hand turned into gold and grabbed the blade.
The sword he thrust out was actually caught by Mark with his bare hands?
"With this little ability, you dare to be arrogant in front of me?"
Chen Shuyi was so frightened that she took two steps back and almost lost her balance.
Golden spiritual power immediately filled the air and lingered around him.
The cultivation level is not the second level of Lingwu Realm, let alone the Qiwu Realm.
He basked in the sun all the way back to the imperial city and advanced again.
